subject.title: [Bug]: Session stuck in permanent busy state after mid-turn gateway restart — no auto-recovery, only /new or /reset clears it

question: What proof and fix combination is sufficient to close this mid-turn restart issue: the open delivery-hook fix, the stale-row/lane-release fixes, or a broader graceful-restart pass?
rationale: Current main contains partial recovery, but the latest field report and source inspection point at multiple remaining ownership boundaries, so automation should not choose a competing fix path or closure criterion.

options.title: Land Related Fixes Then Require Live Restart Proof
options.body: Review or replace the open delivery/stale-row/lane fixes, then close this issue only after a macOS/Telegram or equivalent live restart scenario proves recovery through final delivery.

options.title: Fold Into Graceful-Restart Umbrella
options.body: Move this issue's evidence under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/57425 and keep the broader umbrella as the only tracker for remaining restart recovery policy.

options.title: Sponsor One Core Recovery Redesign
options.body: Pause piecemeal fixes and ask for a single maintainer-owned design covering restart markers, lane release, final delivery, and stale session cleanup.

recommendation.title: Land Related Fixes Then Require Live Restart Proof
recommendation.body: Review or replace the open delivery/stale-row/lane fixes, then close this issue only after a macOS/Telegram or equivalent live restart scenario proves recovery through final delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: They have current maintainer-context involvement on the graceful-restart tracker and recent adjacent gateway/Telegram recovery work, making them the best available owner for the closure/proof threshold.
